'''Arlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and later defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Arlo was assigned to the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] where he served as an assistant [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. During his time on Yavin 4, his immediate superior was a technician named [[Tellulon]]. However, Arlo ignored that Tellulon was in fact a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who had infiltrated the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial armed forces]]. Arlo himself was having second thoughts about the Empire, wondering if it was he was serving the morally just faction.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, Tellulon met a group of Rebel spacers at the Imperial Fortress where he was based with Arlo. Tellulon suggested to a Rebel spacer to attempt to persuade Arlo to defect to the Alliance. The spacer met Arlo who accepted to listen to the Rebel's wisdom, and finally decided to leave the Empire and join the Rebellion. The Rebel spacers later visited [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Verks]] to report the news of Arlo's defection.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCorporalTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Corporal Arlo]]
Arlo appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Arlo was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref>

During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> he could be found in the Imperial Fortress and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Empire Day Revealed|Empire Day Revealed]]," where Rebels had to persuade him to join the Rebellion. Only by being respectful to the Imperial could the Rebel player convince Arlo to defect. If the player was sarcastic or rude to the Imperial, Arlo would decline joining the Alliance, and the player could not complete the quest 100%.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

After the live event ended, Arlo never reappeared in the game, since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
